title: Subset Sum in sub-half-exponential time
coordinate: The worst-case time exponent. The published bound is 0.49, on polynomial-bit inputs, with success probability at least 2/3.
note: The time bound holds on every execution. Repeats of positive integers are allowed. A smaller time exponent is the record this page is asking for.

try.hint: A later record is a smaller time exponent than 0.49. Use an exact expression strictly between 0 and 1. The low-space algorithm uses space_exponent and is not a faster time bound.

companions.title: A low-space algorithm for worst-case Subset Sum
companions.note: A space bound for a different algorithm. It is not a time exponent, and it does not replace 0.49.
